name: Room Works
summary:
RoomWorks is a social VR playground built for playing and having fun about with friends.

Drop into a shared space where you can play many activities, and there's always someone to play against.


MAKE IT YOURS
Change your hair, your face, and your look in the locker room. Everyone can see who you are before you've said a word.

NATURAL VR INTERACTION
